title: scripts/installer.sh: add Omarchy as an Arch derivative
body:
Omarchy (`ID=omarchy`, `ID_LIKE=arch`) isn't in the installer's distro list, so the script falls through to `other-linux` and exits. It uses pacman and the Arch repos, so this adds it to the existing Arch derivative list, the same way openSUSE Slowroll was added in #19662.

Tested in an `archlinux:latest` container with the `/etc/os-release` from the issue mounted in. Before: "Couldn't determine what kind of Linux is running" (`OS=other-linux`). After: the pacman path runs and installs tailscale 1.102.4.

Fixes #21376
